name: @ohmydsh/desktop
description: ohmydsh desktop app: DeepSeek Harness with the ohmydsh plugin set, in its own window
author: T3 Venture Labs <https://github.com/T3-Venture-Labs-Limited>

scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/bundle.mjs && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --x64 --publish never

ohmydsh.electronPinReason: On macOS and Windows (and as the Linux fallback) DSH runs under Electron-as-Node, and its native add-on only accepts Electron 43.0.0, 44.0.0, 44.7.0 or 45.0.0-alpha.6 there; see docs/APPS.md
ohmydsh.nodeNote: Linux x64 bundles this official Node and runs DSH on it (sharp crashes under Electron-as-Node there); DSH needs Node >= 24.9; see docs/APPS.md
